universe: data/teams/sample/ (the curated 32 — the LEGAL exploiter universe per validate_exploiter_trainee_is_sample, and the space every taught team is drawn from)
why_this_universe: The -5.9pp analogue was measured on the 3 rev-3 coverage teams, which are sample teams. Drawing the untaught set from the same universe keeps the comparison on one scale, gives published archetype+WR labels for stratification, and makes the exclusions exact (every taught team is a sample team).

excluded.taught_union_12: read at RUN time from the recorded --trainee-teams of F5a-e + F6a-f + F6CURR (never hand-copied); the probe HARD-FAILS if any pick is in it
excluded.coverage_picks: the 3 rev-3 coverage teams are members of the taught union above, so they are excluded by it
excluded.rejected_original_coverage_picks: NOT RECORDED anywhere in the tree (ledger 61608ac describes the GIGO but does not name the originals). They were rejected BY the curated-32 constraint, i.e. they were NOT sample teams — so drawing exclusively from sample/ excludes them by construction.
excluded.held_out_2: the two held-out teams' ids are likewise unrecorded; the rev-2 capstone calls them 'pool teams', i.e. presumptively non-sample. Residual risk accepted and stated: a coincidence would not corrupt the measurement (a held-out team is untaught either way), it would only mean one row doubles as the narrowness instrument.
excluded.prior_era_exploiter_coverage: every pick below is ALSO uncovered by the E1-E4 substrate exploiters (exploiter_coverage_board.md 'covered by' column = none), so 'never taught' holds across eras, not just across the R2/R3 fleets.

stratification: archetype class x pool win-rate spread. Pool WR is the self-play slice of team_win_rates from models/ai_v9_21_gen17_pfspoff_0820/metadata.json as published in exploiter_coverage_board.md.
known_gap: hyper_offense CANNOT be represented: all 4 hyper_offense sample teams (ZapDug, Jynx SO, Raikou Celebi, MixZap) are in the taught union. The untaught set is structurally balance/stall-heavy, and the fleet's taught set is offense-heavy. Quoted as a caveat on the pooled number.
